title: Project Glasswing
before: Frontier models were released either publicly or not at all.
problem: A model strong enough to help defenders in cybersecurity is also strong enough to help attackers.
breakthrough: A gated consortium giving a small number of trusted organisations access to a model not offered publicly.
why: It established a middle path between open release and no release, for capabilities considered too sensitive for general availability.
next: The Mythos and Fable releases in June, and the export-control episode that followed.
inherits: Tiered, vetted access as a release mode for sensitive capability.
